briefing.headline: xAI Colossus cluster hits 1M H100s as OpenAI prepares o4 launch

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate toward AGI with o4, Claude 4 and Gemini 3 all expected in Q3. Compute scarcity intensifies as sovereign AI programs in EU and UAE secure dedicated foundry capacity. Multi-agent coordination failures now dominate safety discussions.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI internally testing o4 with 4.2T parameters; Anthropic ships Claude 4 Opus early access. Meta releases Llama 4 405B under new commercial license while DeepSeek-V3 tops LMSYS arena.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive and BCI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: xAI activates final 300k GPUs at Memphis supercluster; TSMC begins 2nm risk production for Nvidia Blackwell Ultra. Microsoft secures 40% of UAE G42 power allocation for Azure AI.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first model to demonstrate reliable 30-day autonomous R&D outpace regulatory containment by more than six months?
